findings.text: mergeBookMetadata duplicates mergeBookMetadataWithABS (~27 identical lines differing only in the absMetadata switch case); production uses only mergeBookMetadataWithABS — the duplicate is test-only production duplication that can drift from the real path.

probeAudio computes track/disc twice: sets them via filenameNumbers(..., scanTitle, scanAuthor, scanSeries, scanYear) then unconditionally re-calls filenameNumbers(filename, dir, "", "", "", "") and overwrites both outputs — the Metadata-aware computation is dead work on the main path with potential behavior divergence.

Import path silently swallows sidecar and cleanup failures: '_ = WriteItemMetadata(...)' discards every metadata.json write-back error and '_ = s.cleanupAssociations(ctx, l.id)' discards author/series cleanup errors after commit; no logging — in-scan path hides whole-pipeline sidecar breakage.
parseSequence and trackNumbersFromFilename reachable only from tests — leftover characterization helpers kept alongside the live parse paths.

parseAbsMetadata decodes 'series' twice into two shapes; podcastMetadataObject accepts feedURL/feedUrl, imageURL/imageUrl, podcastType/type case variants via firstValue — bounded upstream dual-payload accept but undocumented beyond a generic note, reads as accidental dual-format.

Hand-rolled bool-chain route matcher (strings.HasPrefix + parts[N]==... splitting) — the pattern AGENTS.md now forbids for new code (codebase-wide, Phase 5); also inconsistent input handling: library ids go through url.PathUnescape but the items/... id is used raw from parts[0].

newID() does id, _ := ids.New() and returns empty string on random-source failure — would silently insert rows with empty primary keys instead of surfacing the error (documented, extremely unlikely, but fake-value fallback rather than error propagation).

importGroup is ~350 lines mixing inode recovery, probe fan-out, book/podcast upserts, author/series joins, event emission; files.go (1.6k non-test LoC) layers discovery, DB import, OPF/ABS/NFO/tag parsing in one file — split candidiate at the edge of maintainable scope.
